findings.title: G3 四态 REAL 的域判定有 2/4 落在 null 上，报告与注册层都没说破
findings.detail: The report's G3 row advertises four REAL states, and the embedded machine JSON it is derived from carries in_domain_fraction = null for level_ice and broken_ice while only pressure_ridge (0.9925) and frazil_event (1.0) were numerically checked. The G3 criterion still reports pass=true. The upstream registration registers only the headline 总判据 (declared_criterion count = 1) and points the embedded_json asset at the section heading, so the null fractions never enter the registered artifact, and none of the six upstream observations mentions them. A downstream 03 step reading 'level_ice=REAL' would inherit a domain verdict with no computed fraction behind it.

evidence.quote: | G3 适用域 | 四态 evidence | 域内 REAL | level_ice=REAL, broken_ice=REAL, pressure_ridge=REAL, frazil_event=REAL | — | PASS |

evidence.note: embedded_json asset locator = section heading only, no block digest

ridge_sail_violations_declared: 6/804 (0.7%) sails outside [0.3,4.0] m where keel/sail ratio is calibrated

findings.impact: Downstream knowledge extraction can turn a vacuous check into a supported claim. The declared parameters themselves do sit inside the stated applicability domain (b=2.05 in [1.5,3.0], D<=90 m <=200 m, dT=0.18 K <=0.2 K), so REAL is defensible on parameter ranges - but not because a fractional check ran.
findings.recommended_action: 03 must mark level_ice/broken_ice domain evidence as parameter-range-based, not fraction-checked; 01 should register the in_domain_fraction values.

findings.title: §3.2 浮冰谱斜率（抽样端）行的三个显示数字互不自洽
findings.detail: Displayed base 2.050, displayed measured 2.170, displayed relative error 5.003e-02. Recomputing from the displayed pair gives 5.854e-02 (gap 8.5e-3 absolute, 17% of the stated error). The stated error implies a measured value of 2.1526, which would display as 2.153 - not 2.170. So either the measured cell or the error cell is a transcription slip. The verdict column ('否') does not flip because both values are >3%, but the row cannot be reproduced from itself.

evidence.quote: | 浮冰谱斜率（抽样端） vs b | 5.003e-02 | 否 |

recomputed.note: the two displayed numbers do not reproduce the displayed relative error; the stated error implies the value in implied_measured_from_stated_err

findings.impact: A downstream claim quoting '5.003e-02' or '2.170' inherits an unreproducible pair; the upstream numeric closure did not catch it because it re-derives 11 hand-picked identities, not the verification tables.
findings.recommended_action: Re-quote the row from artifacts/field_synth_demo.json in the producing repo (not available here); register the row values as assets so 03 can bind to a locator.
